answer: Each identity buys entry to the haven with a 100-unit stake held as insurance. Every epoch auditors re-grade 10 percent of answers; a failed audit hollows the stake to zero and the identity earns no weight for 90 days. The stake unlocks only after the identity crosses an oasis of 90 days of clean graded work. Running 100 fakes costs 10,000 units up front, and each fake caught loses its whole stake.
